grammar.title: 亲自经历举例
lines: 4 When I was a teenager, I felt that I was just young and uncertain -- that I was a new boy in a huge school , and I would have been very pleased to be regarded as something so interesting as a problem. teenager / teen 青少年(13~19) huge school 比喻社会（暗喻） regard / see / count A as B 把A看作B as something so interesting as a problem = Being a problem is better than being a nobody 成为一个问题总比默默无闻好 For one thing , being a problem gives you a certain identity , and that is one of the things the young are busily engaged in seeking . for one thing … for another … 原因之一是… 另一个原因是… be engaged in sth. / doing 忙于某事
in one’s teens 青少年时期 When I was in my teens , I was full of energy. 当我处于青少年时期时，我充满了活力。
adolescent 青少年 / 青春期的(叛逆的) My adolescent daughter is starting to explore her interests. 我青春期的女儿开始探索她的兴趣。
adolescence 青春期(不可数) Many changes occur during adolescence . 青春期会发生许多变化。
juvenile 少年的(法律，可数) Juvenile delinquency / delinquent is a growing concern in some areas. 青少年犯罪在一些地区是个日益严重的问题。
Society is like a huge school where everyone learns from each other. 社会就像一个巨大的学校，每个人都在其中相互学习。
As a newcomer, I felt lost in the huge school of life. 作为一个新人，我在生活的巨大学校中感到迷失。
Navigating the huge school of society can be daunting for young people. 对年轻人来说，探索社会的巨大学校可能令人畏惧。
I would have been pleased if I had been regarded as something so interesting as a problem. 我很高兴被 看作 是一个如此有趣的问题。
That, believe it or not, was one of the findings parents might regard as good news. 信不信由你，家长们 认为 的好消息可能就是这其中一项发现。
They don't value what they regard as inane and pointless. 他们不屑于他们 视为 空无意义的东西。
think of / look on / conceive of A as B 把A看作B They think of him as a reliable leader. 他们认为他是一个可靠的领导者。
consider A (to be) B 认为A是B You would consider octopus a great delicacy in the Mediterranean . 在地中海，你会认为章鱼是一道美味佳肴。
deem / reckon A to be B 认为A是B（书面） They deem him to be the best candidate. 他们认为他是最佳候选人。
be recognized / acknowledged as 被公认为 Heifetz was recognized / acknowledged as the greatest violinist of the 20 th century. 海菲兹被公认为是20世纪最伟大的小提琴家。
Being a problem gives you attention, unlike being ignored. 做问题会让你受到关注，而不是被忽视。
She believed being a problem was better than fading into the background. 她认为做问题总比默默无闻好。
Being a problem means you’re noticed, not overlooked. 做问题意味着你会被注意到，而不是被忽略。
For one thing , I don’t like flying, and for another , I can’t afford it. 原因之一是我不喜欢坐飞机，另一个原因是我负担不起。
For one thing , stereotypes are often accurate. 首先，刻板印象通常很准确。
Don't set him the task. For one thing he's old; for another he's in poor health. 不能让他去干，一则年纪大，二则身体弱。
on the one hand … on the other (hand) … 一方面是… 另一方面是…(矛盾及转折) On the one hand , I’d like a job that pays more, but on the other（hand） , I enjoy my current work. 一方面我想找份薪水更高的工作，另一方面我喜欢现在的工作。

not that … but that … 不是因为… 而是因为…(要求上下文对账) Not that I love Caesar less, but that I love Rome more. 不是因为我爱凯撒少，而是因为我更爱罗马。Shakespeare 'Julius Caesar'. Not that I love you less, but that I love liberty more. Not that I love my teacher less, but that I love truth more.

It is not that … but (that) … 不是因为… 而是因为… It is not that the scales differ, but that the balance is more accurate. 不是因为磅秤不同，而是因为天平更精确。 It was not that I actually remembered anything at all. But my father had described over and over again what we should see at every milestone, after leaving the nearest town ... It is not that the scales in the one case, and the balance in the other, differ in the principles of their construction or manner of working; but that the latter is a much finer apparatus and of course much more accurate in its measurement than the former.
How many spiders are engaged in this work on our behalf ?
The young are engaged in seeking their identity. 年轻人忙于寻找自己的身份。
She is engaged in writing a novel. 她忙于写一部小说。
They are engaged in developing new technology. 他们忙于开发新技术。

sentences.title: 对于青年人的观察
lines: 6 I find young people exciting. find 认为/感觉（书面语） They have an air of freedom , and they have not a dreary commitment to mean ambitions or love of comfort . 他们并不信奉个人主义，也不贪图舒适享受。 air 风度/气质 dreary 单调的/无趣的 They are not anxious social climbers , and they have no devotion to material things . social climber 追求社会地位的人(社会地位专营者) devotion to 对…的奉献（热爱） All this seems to me to link them with life and the origins of things . link … with … 将…与…联系起来 It 's as if they were in some sense cosmic beings in violent and lovely contrast with us suburban creatures . as if / as though 虚拟语气 in some sense 在某种意义上 being ...的存在 in / by contrast / comparison to / with 与…对比 All that is in my mind when I meet a young person. be in one’s mind 记在心中 He may be conceited , ill-mannered, presumptuous or fatuous, but I do not turn for protection to dreary cliches about respect for elders -- as if mere age were a reason for respect . 欲扬先抑 ill- 不良的（非谓语动词作形容词） turn to … for … 向…寻求… He had to turn to his brother for help, because his brother is the only person he could trust. ⇒ He had to turn for help to his brother, the only person he could trust. 改变语序 The long hours in the office or the factory bring with them as their reward, not only the means of sustenance, but a keen appetite for pleasure even in its simplest and most modest forms . age 老年/年长、年纪大的 I accept that we are equals , and I will argue with him, as an equal , if I think he is wrong . as an equal 作为平等的人 写作题材：Claim-Response Pattern 主张反应模式 每日习语 out of this world 极好的、绝妙的
I find young people exciting. 我认为年轻人令人兴奋。
She finds learning new languages rewarding. 她觉得学习新语言很有回报。
We find his ideas inspiring and innovative. 我们认为他的想法鼓舞人心且富有创新性。
They have an air of freedom that inspires others. 他们有一种自由的气质，激励着他人。
She carries an air of confidence in every meeting. 她在每次会议中都带有一种自信的气质。
His air of calmness made everyone feel at ease. 他的平静气质让大家感到放松。
They have not a dreary commitment to mean ambitions. 他们没有对卑微野心的单调承诺。
The dreary routine of daily work bored her. 日常工作的单调例程让她感到厌烦。
The town’s dreary atmosphere made him want to leave. 小镇单调的氛围让他想离开。
They are not anxious social climbers chasing status. 他们不是急于追逐地位的社会攀登者。
He avoided becoming a social climber and valued simplicity. 他避免成为社会攀登者，重视简朴。
Unlike social climbers , she prioritized genuine relationships. 不像社会攀登者，她优先考虑真诚的关系。
They have no devotion to material things. 他们对物质没有奉献。
Her devotion to charity inspired many. 她对慈善的奉献激励了很多人。
His devotion to his work earned him respect. 他对工作的奉献为他赢得了尊重。
All this seems to link them with life and its origins. 这一切似乎将他们与生命及其起源联系起来。
Her speech linked the event with historical changes. 她的演讲将事件与历史变迁联系起来。
The study links diet with improved health outcomes. 这项研究将饮食与改善健康结果联系起来。
It’s as if they were cosmic beings. 仿佛他们是宇宙的存在。
Don’t act as if you were the only pebble on the beach. 不要表现得仿佛你是唯一重要的人。
It looks as if he were talking to someone invisible. 看起来他仿佛在和一个隐形的人说话。
I think he may be right in some sense . 我认为他在某种意义上可能是对的。
Or in some sense does it go just the opposite? 或者某种程度上它会不会恰好是相反的？
In some sense, the use case is path - or goal-based. 从某种意义上说，用例基于路线或目的。
In some sense, they both need the same amount of diapers. 从某种意义上说，他们需要相同数量的尿布。
to some degree/extent 某种程度上 I agree with you to some degree / extent . 我在某种程度上同意你的看法。
in some measure 某种程度上 The true value of a human being is determined primarily by the measure and the sense in which he has attained liberation from the self. -- Albert Einstein
living being (生物；有生命的存在物)
supreme being (至高存在；神)
Man is a sentient being . 人是有感觉的生物。
To be , or not to be : that is the question. ——William Shakespeare 生存、毁灭：这还是个问题
I think therefore I am . —— René Descartes 我思顾我在
Being and Nothingness —— Jean Paul Sartre 存在与虚无
human being 人类（唯一可数表“人类”） Every human being deserves respect. 每个人类都值得尊重。
intelligent being 智慧生物 Scientists search for intelligent beings in the universe. 科学家在宇宙中寻找智慧生物。
alien being 外星人 The movie depicted an alien being visiting Earth. 这部电影描述了一个外星人造访地球。
They are cosmic beings in contrast with us suburban creatures. 他们是宇宙的存在，与我们郊区生物形成对比。
Her approach is innovative by comparison with traditional methods. 她的方法与传统方法相比是创新的。
Compared to last year, sales have improved significantly. 与去年相比，销售额显著提高。
in contrast to / with 与…对比/相比 In contrast to his brother, he is very shy and quiet. 与 他兄弟 相比 ，他非常害羞和安静。
by contrast 相比之下/与之形成对比 The North of the country is very industrialized; by contrast , the South is largely agricultural. 该国北部工业化程度很高； 相比之下 ，南部基本上是农业。
in comparison to / with 与…对比/比较 The old model is quite slow in comparison with the new version. 与 新版本 相比 ，旧型号相当慢。
by comparison 相比之下 The first task took all morning, but the second one was very quick by comparison . 第一个任务花了一整个上午，但 相比之下 第二个任务很快就完成了。
All that is in my mind when I meet a young person. 当我遇到年轻人时，这些都在我心中。
Peace is in my mind ! 和平在我心中！
I keep thinking about him, his face is in my mind constantly, eating me away. 我一直想着他，他的脸总出现在我脑海中，萦绕着。
be on one’s mind 牵挂着 The upcoming exam is on my mind all day. 即将到来的考试整天让我牵挂。
ill-advised
ill-educated
ill-tempered
ill-gotten 不义之财的；非法获得的 (e.g., ill-gotten gains)
ill-use 虐待；滥用 (指不良使用)
ill-treatment 虐待；不公正的对待
ill-conduct 不良行为；不检点
ill-doing 犯罪；作恶
ill-advised 不明智的；欠考虑的；不恰当的建议
ill-mannered 无礼的 He may be ill-mannered , but I respect his honesty. 他可能无礼，但我尊重他的诚实。
ill-treated 虐待的 Ill-treated animals need better care. 被虐待的动物需要更好的照顾。
ill-bred 缺乏教养的 His ill-bred behavior shocked the guests. 他缺乏教养的行为让客人们震惊。
well-bred 有教养的 She is a well-bred young lady with excellent manners. 她是一位教养良好的年轻女士，举止优雅。
well-informed 见多识广的 A well-informed decision is based on solid facts. 见多识广的决定基于坚实的事实。
The child turned to his mother for comfort. 孩子向母亲寻求安慰。
The refugees turned to the embassy for protection. 难民向大使馆寻求保护。
I turned to my mentor for advice on the project. 我向导师寻求项目建议。
An idle youth, a needy age . 少壮不努力，老大徒伤悲。
The age of the building made it less appealing. 大楼的老化使其吸引力下降。
With age comes wisdom, but not always respect. 随着年龄增长，智慧增加，但不总是有尊重。
I will argue with him as an equal . 我将以平等的身份与他争论。
She treated everyone as an equal regardless of status. 她平等对待每个人，不论地位高低。
We should communicate as equals to foster mutual respect. 我们应以平等身份交流以促进相互尊重。
claim 给出某人的观点
response 给出作者自己的响应，或支持、或反对、或半支持半反对
reasons for response 对理由进行分析解释
relevant example(s) 举出相关例子
reaffirmation 进一步强调加强作者的响应
